score_manifest: Explicit frozen panel binding and exactly nine score receipt bindings; externally frozen manifest SHA required before evaluator reads labels
missing_or_failed_block_behavior: HOLD; never evaluate a favorable completed subset
bundle_authentication: Require all-three pre-score manifest hashes; verify each scope manifest, all five bundle artifacts, implementation and source-input provenance
attribution_controls: Within one fitted model, host-only scores for an identical host must not depend on phage; phage-only scores for an identical phage must not depend on host
ranking: Use pinned within-model blocked ranking, informative blocks per phage then phages per genetic group then equal group mean; no cross-model raw-margin host ordering
screen: Descriptive paired group-macro concordance strictly >0.5 and strictly >host-only on exact same units; absent informative units is HOLD
report: Full score matrices, informative counts, group deltas, eligible-row coverage and scored fraction of full source observation roster, unknown-pair count
inference: Exploratory retrospective source spot-clearance screen; no significance/independent-replicate/generalization/native plaque/assembly claim
